- Effect. Except as amended here, the Master Services Agreement remains in full force. Where this Amendment conflicts with the Master Services Agreement, this Amendment controls. [amendment_01_msa §1.3]
- Cap. Except as provided in Sections 4.2 and 4.3, each party's aggregate liability arising out of this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim. [msa_acme_vendor §4.1]
